name: duopore-public-move-one-off-costs
description: Work out the upfront cash for a move while keeping refundable deposits separate.
keywords: see the cash a move needs

interface.shortDescription: See the cash a move needs
interface.longDescription: Work out the upfront cash for a move while keeping refundable deposits separate. List one-time costs, deposits and estimates you still need to confirm. Add a buffer for those estimates and compare the cash needed with your reserve. This uses your own costs; it does not fetch prices or promise that a deposit will be returned.
capabilities: See the cash a move needs
defaultPrompt: How much upfront cash does my move need?
Keep refundable deposits separate from one-time moving costs.
